newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen trending higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen trending higher at open.

text.p: * Toronto stocks were likely to play catch-up at Tuesday's open with the strength in other markets after being closed for a civic holiday on Monday. * Eye on Alcan.
Toronto's key stock index will likely drift higher at Tuesday's open, boosted by strength in other markets on Monday when the Toronto market was shut for a public holiday.
"We may pick up a little bit here," one trader said, after a four-point gain in New York on Monday. "We should probably be on the up side."

Toronto snapped a four-day winning streak on Friday after unexpectedly strong U.S. economic data rekindled fears of an interest rate hike. The Toronto Stock Exchange's 300 Composite Index fell 26.54 points to close at 6851.14.
